The online retailer has long been USPS' top customer, providing more than $6 billion in annual revenue in 2025, the report said. ‌Losing its business would be a major blow to the independent government agency that has been hit by an 80% decline in first-class mail volume since 1997.  For Amazon, building ‌out its delivery network would bolster its standing in a parcel industry where it is already a major player thanks to its sprawling warehouse network and a largely non-union workforce that has allowed it to control costs.
